output.arguments:
{"code": "
import scipy.io.wavfile as wav
import numpy as np

# 讀取兩個音檔
rate1, data1 = wav.read('/tmp/tone440.wav')
rate2, data2 = wav.read('/tmp/whitenoise.wav')

print(f"tone440.wav: rate={rate1}, shape={data1.shape}, dtype={data1.dtype}")
print(f"whitenoise.wav: rate={rate2}, shape={data2.shape}, dtype={data2.dtype}")

# 確保兩個音檔 sample rate 相同
if rate1 != rate2:
    raise ValueError(f"Sample rate 不匹配: {rate1} vs {rate2}")

# 確保維度相同（轉換為 float 避免 overflow）
if data1.ndim == 1:
    data1 = data1.reshape(-1, 1)
if data2.ndim == 1:
    data2 = data2.reshape(-1, 1)

# 取兩者較短的長度，確保維度相容
min_len = min(len(data1), len(data2))
data1 = data1[:min_len]
data2 = data2[:min_len]

# 混合兩個音訊（音量各減半避免 clip）
merged = (data1.astype(np.float32) + data2.astype(np.float32)) / 2

# 轉回原始 dtype 並寫入
wav.write('/tmp/merged.wav', rate1, merged.astype(data1.dtype))

print(f"✓ 已合併為 /tmp/merged.wav ({min_len} samples, {min_len/rate1:.2f} 秒)")
"}
